propositions: Bridge orchestration must be extracted into a runner-neutral packaged Python core exposed through Python library (rebar.bridge_run), CLI (rebar bridge run --profile), and MCP (bridge_run tool), with support for all three install paths: pip wheel, Homebrew wheel-backed environment, and MCP Registry/uvx.

The five profiles (reconcile-check, dry-run, bootstrap-strict, bootstrap-throttle, live) must map to legacy rebar reconcile and bridge commands while preserving existing provider MODE environment variable support and direct legacy reconcile caller behavior.

Provider wrappers (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab) must invoke the installed rebar bridge run CLI entrypoint rather than repository-local scripts; GitLab wrapper must validate against vendored immutable Draft-07 schema with SHA-256 provenance and embedded shell must pass pinned ShellCheck linting.

Legacy benign reconcile results (3/4/75) must be preserved for direct callers while the new runner maps them to canonical success (0), and exact valid pause markers must skip delivery without silent failures.
Strict delivery must be invoked on every successful non-paused pass with run id, bot identity, and REBAR_SYNC_PUSH=always; shallow repositories must return invalid invocation before reconciliation.
